title: REQ · A Phaser-backed RenderContext draws sprites from engine specs
summary: createPhaserRenderContext implements RenderContext.createSprite with Phaser images
description: Context: RenderContext and RenderHandle exist in game/src/engine/renderContext.ts, but only EffectRenderContext has a Phaser implementation (effectContext.ts). Desired behavior: a Phaser implementation creates an image per RenderSpriteSpec at its position, scale and depth, with hover highlight, a name label, visibility, hit bounds and click. Expected result: SceneObject can render in Phaser. Why: it is the only missing piece between buildScene and the canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Given a RenderSpriteSpec, when createSprite runs, then an image is added with key resolved through resolveKey, the spec x, y, scale and depth
Given spec.bounds, when createSprite runs, then the image is made interactive with a hit rectangle equal to the bounds
Given a handle, when setHighlighted(true) and setLabelVisible(true) are called, then a tint is applied and the label text is shown, and both are cleared on false
Given a handle, when destroy runs, then the image and the label are destroyed
technical_constraints: Resolve texture keys through an injected resolveKey function so the fallback texture applies
definition_of_done: createPhaserRenderContext is exported and implements RenderContext
